attributes.name: Sistrum of Bastet
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d6; you may additionally discard this card to add your Charisma or Dexterity skill. 

Recharge this card to add 1d8 to your Charisma or Diplomacy check. 

Recharge this card to add 1d4 to any check by a character at your location.

corrections.corrected_text: On the weapon Sistrum of Bastet, change "discard this card to use your Strength or Melee skill" to "reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill".
corrections.issue: Sistrum of Bastet says you can discard it to use your Strength or Melee skill, and additionally discard it to add your Charisma or Dexterity skill. How can you discard it if you already discarded it?
